title: Gold Rush: Mine Rescue With Freddy & Juan
description: Freddy and Juan face a failing dry mine in Arizona run by military veterans; when a monsoon wreaks havoc on the rescue, they create their first-ever pay dryer system to quadruple the gold yield.

title: Gold Rush: Mine Rescue With Freddy & Juan
description: After losing his job, Fred Dickinson enlists the help of Freddy and Juan to rescue his homemade operation, tap into one of Arizona's richest gold veins and provide for his young family of seven.

title: Gold Rush: White Water
description: Desperate to find gold and save his mining career, Dustin Hurt is ready to risk the lives of his entire crew by chasing gold at the bottom of a deadly waterfall; an all-out mutiny changes the course of his season.

title: Auction Kings
description: The Gallery 63 team takes in two chairs that may have come from a New Orleans cat house and a 1969 Oldsmobile 442; a young soldier raising money for his wedding brings in a WWII Japanese rifle and sword.

title: Live to Farm
description: Watermelon harvest brings fun, but who's up for the competition?; Kevin hosts his annual MACC consulting group field day.

title: Mysteries of the Abandoned: Hidden America
description: A Revolutionary leader visits Alabama's first capital and leaves it bankrupt; an Oregon fort refuses to engage an enemy submarine during World War II; a film studio in Jacksonville, Fla. caters to a new audience.

title: Mysteries of the Abandoned: Hidden America
description: A research facility spawns new technology with earth-shattering implications; a coastal haven for African Americans changes the nation; a forgotten fortress fights off a Nazi submarine; a staunch building stands firm on San Francisco's darkest day.

title: Mysteries of the Abandoned: Hidden America
description: A rural town in Oregon is invaded by an eccentric cult, a battered building in Florida plays a major role in the cigar trade, and a junkyard palace in New Jersey becomes the subject of controversy and rumors of the supernatural.

title: Mysteries of the Abandoned: Hidden America
description: The remains of Idaho's nuclear industry mark a new era of American history; a distillery in rural Kentucky revolutionizes liquor; a New England settlement prospers despite prejudice; subterranean chambers produce many of the nation's monuments.

title: Expedition Unknown
description: Josh hunts for missing Confederate gold, exploring a wagon train robbery site where stolen coins vanished; then, a fresh eyewitness lead points directly to Jefferson Davis's lost war chest.

title: Expedition Unknown
description: Josh tracks down the legend and treasure of an outlaw posse, who terrorized the Midwest's railroads; Josh tracks the Reno Gang's lost loot to a cave hideout that could hold millions.

title: Expedition Unknown
description: Josh braves the frigid, shark-infested waters off Cape Cod to dive the world's only confirmed pirate wreck; joining a high-tech recovery mission, Josh chases the multi-million-dollar treasure of Black Sam Bellamy, including coins, gold and jewels.

title: Expedition Unknown
description: Josh joins archeologists as they bushwhack through thick jungles and rappel into vast caves in search of the lost Zoque culture; deep underground, the team pushes through flooded sections and finds thousands of ritual offerings that may solve the mystery.

title: Expedition Unknown
description: Josh braves the African savanna to investigate the rampage of two lions who killed as many as 135 railroad workers in 1898; to prevent more bloodshed, Josh joins wildlife rangers tracking a pair of rogue lions who are on a modern-day killing spree.

title: Naked and Afraid
description: In an international tribes challenge, one survivalist must cope with menstruation in the middle of the African bush.

title: Naked and Afraid
description: A hunter and a farmer pool their knowledge to survive 21 days in South Africa; when the African wildlife proves too stealthy to hunt, the survivalists take a life-threatening risk for food.

title: Naked and Afraid
description: Four survivalists seek redemption for their past failures; however, their promises to make it through 21 days on a remote Philippine lake are put to the test when they accidentally ingest a toxic substance.

description: "Naked and Afraid" legend Laura Zerra returns to mentor a blacksmith and a former MMA fighter as they attempt to survive 21 days in Yucatán; scant food resources, deadly crocodiles and violent storms shake their confidence.

title: Jeff Dunham's the Cars That Drove Us
description: Before becoming America's Sports Car, the Chevrolet Corvette was the bane of General Motors' existence; when the automaker attempted to discontinue the line in 1983, a small team of self-funded true believers went rogue, sparking a civil war within GM.

title: Adventure Cities
description: Seasoned travel writer Jonathan Thompson explores the spirit that brings Tampa Bay to life -- from pirate cannons and flamenco dancing, to Cuban sandwiches, cigar rolling and thrilling roller coasters.

title: Guided: The Reel Story of Louisiana Guides
description: Science, saltwater and sportsmen; our friends at Louisiana Wildlife and Fisheries take us on a guided tour aboard the stingray -- the state's new saltwater electrofishing boat -- to show how cutting-edge science helps manage the fish that guides and anglers depend on.

title: Tomorrow's World Today
description: George sends Greg to the World of Innovation to explore how one company is transforming the supplement industry through traceability, science-backed formulations and rigorous clinical research.

title: Gold Rush
description: Rick hires an engineer to see if he can mine again this season; Parker's crew struggles to keep four plants running; Tony tries to double his gold.

title: Gold Rush
description: Rick prospects new ground on Duncan Creek; Tony tasks Nick to deliver their biggest haul of the year; Buzz finds a feeder to increase production.

title: Gold Rush
description: Parker buys a new plant to mine the promising Road Cut; Tony's crew runs bedrock to keep gold flowing; Greg and Buzz decode mysterious black pay dirt.

title: Caught!
description: Convicts making last efforts to break free when their hands are tied; whether a crook on trial or an inmate with a corrections officer, handcuffs, cops and prison walls won't stop these guys from their escaping attempts.

description: Hilarious clips showing that everyone has a wild side; people recording some unexpected events.

title: Caught!
description: Police takedowns can be risky business, especially when criminals are armed and dangerous; that's why officers rely on non-lethal tactics like tasers, bean bag rounds, and K-9 units to subdue suspects when things get a little too close for comfort.

description: Near Gary, S.D., expert chasers and certified weather spotters self-shoot an encounter with a long-track, shape-shifting tornado; when the twister takes a turn towards an occupied farmhouse, chasers are thrust into the role of first responders.
